Give it a miss!
Sep 2026 • Couples
An extremely disappointing experience from the get go! Despite a booking in an almost empty restaurant, we were sent to a back room with little decoration and no atmosphere - we could see quite nicely decorated areas. Shove all the foreigners together by dismissive staff who seemed to be employed for their looks rather than customer service? Every request was ignored.
Four dishes order for 2 people. vegetables arrived first. Despite a query for the remainder of the food being after 10 minutes, a protein arrived after about 20 minutes. It was tough and cold, as were the vegetables. Hindsight is wonderful - should have just got up and left. It didn't get better food was ordinary and not presented in a style expected of such a rated restaurant. Is it the
 best Hanoi could offer to warrant a star?
Save your money, go to the "Obama" restaurant - at least it will be a fun experience.

JJMayburg

Madame Binh and Michelin Bib should be embarrassed
Feb 2026 • Couples
Just so disappointing. To be extremely specific, we ordered the grilled eggplant - the greasiest eggplant I have ever had in VN. Dripping with oil and no freshness about it We also ordered the braised redtail catfish with pork belly, tofu, Vietnamese herbs and then the "marinated" boneless chicken with blushing apricot. Just so deeply disappointed. The braised fish was tough as hell and the Vietnamese herbs were missing in action. Chicken the same - tough as and nothing marinated about it. Way too much chewy skin and the meat was dry as hell. What was obvious was the complete lack of care. We're used to being provided beautiful fresh herbs .. what's with the dull lettuce? And flavours - a small dish of soy sauce only? Absolutely no sauces that brought the lovely fresh, salty sweet delicate flavours of Vietnam. Honestly, I felt embarrassed for the young staff. Mrs Binh, sort your kitchen and care again. We didn't just choose badly either as all the other tables looked equally uninspired. Should have paid attention to the recent reviews.

I expected more
Jan 2026 • Couples
Our guide recommended this place for nice dinner on our last night in Hanoi. We had the beef tenderloin, chicken stir fry, rolls and water. Some items were not available so we had to go with 2nd choices. Water was not cold so we had to get ice with it. The chicken dish reminded me of Korean bbq which was tasty. The beef tenderloin was just average. The rice was super sticky and black. Not my cup of tea. We dined at 6pm on Wednesday and it was not busy yet. The people who dined were all tourists. The service was fine. They weren’t slow or trying to rush us out. It was a good experience but I wish more of their dishes were available at the time.
